migration_path: Move app-specific U0 ownership into apps_research and make L6 parity consume only generic profile-driven identities and digests.
blocking_migration_reason: Existing production importers still consume compatibility paths while the issue #550 exact-byte and current-run identity contract is rolled out.
adapter_only_justification: Issue #550 changes only validation and observer adapters: bounded authority scanning, identity propagation, exact byte-digest comparison, and fail-closed parity. It adds no app-specific policy decision, threshold, app_id branch, route choice, current-run rescue, or write authority to shared core.
justification: Issue #550 hardens exact-byte parity, complete current-run identity, cycle-safe authority scanning, fail-closed proof semantics, and thin product-entry delegation in pre-existing app-named core adapters. The diff adds no app_id or tenant branching and no app-specific policy threshold. The exception prevents those existing adapter names from concealing the generic security hardening while their app projection is migrated out of core.
migration_target: Profile-driven generic L6 parity and runtime-exhaust contracts, with Apps Eval projection under apps_eval; Apps Research U0 ownership under apps_research/runtime/u0.
target_location: agentic_core/L6_observability/shadow_eval plus apps_eval and apps_research owned adapters
acceptance_criteria: Core parity consumes a generic identity-and-digest contract without Apps Eval vocabulary
Apps-specific scorecard projection is owned by apps_eval
Apps Research U0 binding is owned by apps_research or uses the generic package-driven U0 binder
Apps RG product dispatch is registered through a generic app-entry mechanism
The six GOV-3 baseline entries are removed
